ice.text: Mikkel is a village in the hinterlands of Kjeldor, where a great storm keeps its inhabitants from Krov and only Halvor and Kaysa reach the church for the Feast of Kjeld.
Disa, Lucilde and Klazina take refuge there from the storm, and Kolbjörn arrives to take Kaysa to Fyndhorn, warning that the undead villagers will kill Halvor.

Avram Garrisson then arrives and reveals that he allied himself with Lim-Dul and became undead, and when the undead villagers break into the church, Kolbjörn and Kaysa chant the song of Freyalise, which strips them of life.
Halvor lets Kaysa go with Kolbjörn, and the six survivors bury the dead and abandon the village, heading south toward Fyndhorn.
